name: MonarchFunnelChart
title: FunnelChart
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column and Row with androidx.compose.foundation.background bars, inside MonarchChartFrame; androidx.compose.foundation.clickable for selectable stages
summary: A conversion funnel: how many reach each step, the share that continues to the next step and how many drop off.
whenToUse: To show a fixed sequence of steps that people pass through, such as sign-up or hiring, where the drop between steps matters.
whenNotToUse: For values that are not steps of one flow, use MonarchBarList. For change over time, use a line or bar chart in MonarchChartFrame.
api: @Composable fun MonarchFunnelChart(title: String, stages: List<MonarchFunnelChartStage>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = MonarchChartFrameStatus.Ready, alignment: MonarchFunnelChartAlignment = MonarchFunnelChartAlignment.Center, showSteps: Boolean = true, summary: String? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, footer: String? = null, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, formatRate: ((Double) -> String)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onSelect: ((MonarchFunnelChartStage) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchFunnelChartLabels = MonarchFunnelChartLabels())
class MonarchFunnelChartStage(label: String, value: Double, key: String = label, color: MonarchChartColor? = null)

class MonarchFunnelChartLabels(frame: MonarchChartFrameLabels = MonarchChartFrameLabels(), stage: String? = null, value: String? = null, fromPrevious: String? = null, ofFirst: String? = null, step: String? = null, stages: ((count: Int, first: String, last: String) -> String)? = null, overall: String? = null, largestDrop: String? = null, describeFirst: String? = null, describe: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The name of the chart, shown as the frame's heading.

options.name: description
options.description: One line under the title, such as the period.

options.name: status
options.description: Ready, Loading, Empty or Error. A ready chart without stages shows the empty state.

options.name: alignment
options.description: Centered bars read as a funnel; Start bars begin at the start edge and are easier to compare.

options.name: showSteps
options.description: Shows the line between stages with the share that continued and the number dropped.

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated summary that TalkBack reads for the stages.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the empty state.

options.name: footer
options.description: Notes under the chart, such as the source.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes a count. The default is a number in the current locale.

options.name: formatRate
options.description: Writes a share from 0 to 1. The default is a percentage in the current locale with at most one decimal.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error status.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Makes every stage a button, for example to list the people who dropped.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the frame's. Sentences with values are format strings with %1$s placeholders; the stage count sentence is a function so it can follow the language's plural rules.

states.name: ready
states.description: One row per stage: the step line, the label with its value and share of the first stage, and the bar.

states.name: pressed
states.description: A selectable stage shows the Material ripple while pressed and the Monarch focus ring when focused from a keyboard.

states.name: table
states.description: View as table replaces the bars with the counts, the share of the previous stage and the share of the first.

states.name: empty
states.description: The frame's empty state, also when the chart is ready but has no stages.

states.name: loading
states.description: The frame's skeleton at the chart's height.

states.name: error
states.description: The frame's error message, with Try again when onRetry is given.

appearance: Bars use the first data color (or the stage's palette slot) on the card surface. Labels and values are default text, the share and the step line muted text, in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web FunnelChart highlights a stage on hover and keyboard focus and announces it in a live region; on Android there is no hover, so every stage is its own TalkBack element instead, and a selectable stage is a button with a ripple. The web controlled activeIndex is not offered. Web align start is MonarchFunnelChartAlignment.Start and mirrors right to left. Number formats are functions instead of Intl options. The step line has no arrow glyph, as Monarch bundles no icons. The stage count sentence is a plural resource, replaced with a function, where iOS takes two strings. The rest of the names match iOS (showsSteps is showSteps, following Compose naming).
accessibility: The stages are a traversal group whose content description is the generated summary: the number of stages, the overall conversion and the largest drop, or the summary given.
Each stage is one TalkBack element read as its label and value, then the share of the previous and of the first stage; it carries its position as a collection item.
With onSelect each stage is a button with a touch target of at least 48dp and the Monarch focus ring.
Bars are decoration; every number they show is also text.
The frame title is a heading, and View as table lists every count and share.
The chart measures its stages, so at font scale 2.0 labels wrap and the chart grows instead of overlapping the footer.
edgeCases: Negative and non-finite values count as zero.
A stage after a stage of zero continues at 0%, without dividing by zero.
A stage larger than the one before shows a share above 100% and is not counted as a drop.
A value above zero but tiny next to the widest stage still draws a sliver of bar.
Stage keys default to the label, so give a key when two stages share a label.
The first frame uses an estimated height (76dp per stage with step lines, 56dp without, never under 120dp); the measured height replaces it on the next frame.

examples.title: Sign-up funnel
Aligned to the start edge, selectable, without step lines
examples.code:
MonarchFunnelChart(
    title = "Hiring pipeline",
    stages = listOf(
        MonarchFunnelChartStage("Applied", 120.0),
        MonarchFunnelChartStage("Interviewed", 30.0),
        MonarchFunnelChartStage("Hired", 4.0),
    ),
    alignment = MonarchFunnelChartAlignment.Start,
    showSteps = false,
    onSelect = { selected = it.label },
)
